snippet.title: No More Room in Hell 2 | Launch Date Announce
snippet.description:
We're excited to share that No More Room in Hell 2 launches onto PlayStation and Xbox and leaves Early Access with the Armageddon Update on August 11th!

With this release comes our new Survival mode with 3 distinct locations as well as a sixth Objective map: Raven Rock, alongside a whole host of improvements, features, and fixes that make this update our largest yet. With full crossplay at launch, survive hell together no matter where your friends play!

Coming to Consoles on August 11th:
https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/no-more-room-in-hell-2/9pf1q2f7jm9g
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019078

AVAILABLE NOW in Early Access: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/292000/No_More_Room_in_Hell_2/
https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/no-more-room-in-hell-2-ea1b5c

About No More Room in Hell 2:
No More Room in Hell 2 is an intense permadeath co-op journey into the eerie darkness of zombie-infested zones. As an emergency responder you must survive, scavenge, stockpile and fulfill your mission - then repeat, each time in an ever-changing experience.

About Torn Banner:
Torn Banner Studios is an exciting independent video game company located in Toronto, Canada. Passion and innovation are the core elements of everything that we do. We are people that truly love games and are lucky enough to be following our dreams, thanks to the incredible support from our communities of players.
